findings.evidence: execute() does not runtime-enforce binding.request_id == request.request_id. The journal is keyed by binding.request_id while the FC-704 envelope reconciles by resolution.request_id (the request's URN); a divergent binding id would silently degrade the envelope (structural outcome, download_events=0) while the txn still reports completed. The contract pins the equality via CG-03/04/06/07 (all pass matching ids) and the CLI reads request_id from the binding file, so no live path can diverge accidentally. Plan does not mandate the check; a defensive early-reject would harden it. No action required for acceptance.

cli.py close-gap accepts --mode exact|latest_as_of but the handler never reads args.mode — the transaction hard-codes latest_as_of for revalidation and exact for fetch (the fixed step sequence). Inert CLI surface; harmless. No action required.
